Data Entry Clerk — Work From Home

Example DigitalRemote (Canada)Posted Sep 16, 2026

RemoteContractNo ExperienceDemo listing

About this role

Sample listing for a six-month data entry contract. The clerk transfers records between systems, checks them against source documents and reports anything that looks inconsistent.

Responsibilities

  • Enter and verify records in the company's internal database
  • Cross-check entries against scanned source documents
  • Maintain a daily accuracy rate above the agreed threshold
  • Report inconsistent or missing source data to the team lead

Requirements

  • Typing speed of at least 45 words per minute
  • Comfortable with spreadsheets and repetitive detail work
  • Able to follow written procedures precisely
  • Located in Canada for payroll reasons

Benefits

  • Set weekday schedule with no evening work
  • Equipment provided for the contract period
  • Possible extension after six months

Skills

Data EntryExcelGoogle SheetsAccuracyTyping
